headline: AI Single-Rack Prices Rise Sharply; AMAX-KY Pursues Growth Through Three Drivers - Liberty Finance
summary: AMAX-KY chairman Ni Hsiao-ching said AI single-rack prices are rising sharply. He cited three growth drivers: AI infrastructure services, NPI-to-mass-production manufacturing, and liquid cooling and full-rack system design.
why: AMAX-KY is a Taiwan-listed server and computing hardware maker serving AI infrastructure buyers. Server rack pricing reflects demand for AI data center equipment.
